acceptance_signals: The first implementation write captures the exact task-start baseline; every pre-existing file under broad inventory-classification prefixes remains byte-identical unless it is one of the exact implementation or closeout paths named by this requirement.
A dependency-free evidence receipt and cleanup gate live only under scripts/short_build_root and preserve the existing verified-root removal boundary.

The receipt accepts only a repository-relative evidence path beneath the supplied repository, a regular non-link file, and a canonical sha256-prefixed lowercase hexadecimal identity matching the observed bytes.
Evidence validation completes before the existing removal helper is invoked; every validation failure leaves the exact short root present and records no cleanup success.
Successful validation delegates exactly once to the existing exact-root cleanup helper and confirms the verified root is removed.
The gate never calls input, reads stdin, or branches on TTY state; tests prove identical bounded behavior with TTY-reported input, redirected input, and closed input.
Tests cover success, missing evidence, absolute or escaping path, symbolic-link evidence where supported, malformed digest, digest mismatch, unsafe evidence type, and preservation on failure.

No wheel build, dependency installation, network access, retry, backend substitution, public CLI or installed-package change, consumer run, external Agent, model, Git mutation, publication, release, or deployment occurs.
The focused helper tests, complete Python 3.11 suite, task and repository governance, final scope comparison, task JSON parse, and diff whitespace check pass.

Only the new task record and baseline, scripts/short_build_root implementation and tests, new dated validation record, docs/development-automation-contracts.md, STATUS.md, and docs/development-log/2026-08-25.md may change during this task; predecessor records and evidence remain unchanged.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-2186fb4fb7254ea7acbbc6186c0c4f30 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Extend the existing repository-internal short-build-root helper with a dependency-free evidence receipt and gated cleanup operation. Cleanup may proceed only when an explicit repository-relative regular non-link evidence file exists and its SHA-256 matches the caller-supplied identity. The gate never reads stdin or depends on TTY state, verifies evidence before invoking the existing exact-root removal helper, and leaves the root untouched on missing, unsafe, linked, malformed, or mismatched evidence. Add fixture-backed tests for TTY-reported, redirected, and closed-input callers and document the bounded contract. Do not run another artifact build or broaden public AgentGov behavior.

items: A cleanup gate defect could remove a temporary root before evidence is durable; validation order and mock-backed no-removal tests are mandatory.
A path traversal or link could make unrelated evidence satisfy the gate; path containment, regular-file, and no-link checks must fail closed.
A digest formatting ambiguity could authorize cleanup incorrectly; only canonical sha256-prefixed lowercase hexadecimal identity is accepted.
Changes to the existing short-root helper could weaken its exact-target safety; existing tests must remain unchanged in meaning and continue to pass.
Broad prefixes used for dirty-inventory classification must not become implementation authority for predecessor files; exact changed-path review is mandatory.
Reviewed assumption: The existing scripts.short_build_root verified-root value and removal helper remain the correct deletion authority boundary.
Reviewed assumption: A repository-relative durable evidence file plus exact SHA-256 is sufficient to prove evidence existed before cleanup for this local contract.
Reviewed assumption: The same explicit programmatic receipt can serve interactive and noninteractive callers without reading their input streams.

Reviewed assumption: Broad governance, baseline, and build-validation prefixes are used only to classify the current dirty inventory within the native proposal limit; predecessor files under them are immutable acceptance evidence.
Reviewed unknown: Whether future callers should persist the evidence receipt in a separate state file is not decided.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform symbolic-link test availability is environment-dependent.
Reviewed unknown: This contract does not prove a future artifact build, external Agent journey, adoption, reliability improvement, time savings, causal benefit, or return on investment.

title: Evidence-gated noninteractive short-root cleanup v1
